items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: The interviewee discusses George Lewis' band's future and mentions hearing Ken Howard with George, but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction with George Lewis himself.

ctx.x: Kubrick and Roddy And the first in I don't think we said much about them

Well I don't know that there's really a lot to say Except that they That they came on this particular story That they were pretty competent people That they somehow were able to listen to good advice That is advice that we gave them Basically Greenwood and you and I And that they came out with What we considered to be an excellent article That had a lot of influence on Particularly on George Lewis' band's future Because I don't think I don't think the band had Done any appreciable amount of traveling or touring…
And certainly George was discouraged As he told Greenwood and he told Meaghan He was about ready to quit Things didn't help up
